regions.merged_text: Many thanks for your generous supply of my favorite general remedy, Ben Gay -- Baume Bengue. The same ought to hold me a long time, now that my Eczema is pretty well cleared up. I hope this finds you all well and well dis- posed for special graces these blessed days. -- and a Joy- ful Easter tide.
